thread:
eva (product): Quick thread: alignment needed on 'Snapshot API' for enterprise compliance customers. We have three customer asks: 1) scheduled immutable snapshots with signed manifests, 2) per-tenant retention labels (standard/extended/legacy) selectable via API, 3) ability to request on-demand frozen exports for legal hold.

sam (eng): Sketch of implementation: snapshot job runs hourly for high-tier tenants, daily for standard. Each snapshot creates a manifest, writes blobs to cold storage + index entry pointing to manifest. On-demand freeze = mark retention_label=legal-hold + create export job.

nora (security): Security constraints: manifests must include algorithm, key id, and a timestamped signature. For BYOK tenants we should support either: (A) Redwood-signed manifest + customer-signed envelope OR (B) direct customer-managed signing (if they provide a KMS signing endpoint). Need threat model for option B.

pia (legal): For 7y retention 'extended', we need contract language and a documented deletion-override flow for legal holds. Also confirm jurisdictional export controls (EU vs US) for cross-region snapshots.

lucas (sre): Operationally, hourly snapshots for many tenants will spike ledger writes and index. We should gate hourly snapshots to "Dedicated" tier or purchase-backed tenants. Otherwise default daily. Also add rate limiter for on-demand exports.

dan (sales): Customers asking for searchable exports too (not just blobs). Want an indexable package (sqlite or ndjson) to run quick queries. That's a huge selling point.

sam (eng): Indexing tradeoffs: generating an ndjson index alongside the manifest adds CPU and storage but enables immediate query. Alternative: delayed indexing pipeline (post-snapshot) that makes exports searchable within 24-72h.

eva (product): Proposed launch criteria: (1) Snapshot API supports scheduled and on-demand snapshots; (2) Manifest format v1 includes file list, sha256, size, signed_by metadata; (3) Legal-hold flag prevents deletion and surfaces audit events; (4) Searchable package option available but may be "beta" with 24-72h indexing SLA.

nora (security): Add: all export requests emit audit events with requestor identity and reason. Export artifacts must be tamper-evident; include chain-of-custody header with previous snapshot hash if incremental.

sam (eng): Example manifest (short):

```
manifest_v1:
- tenant_id: t-6789
- snapshot_id: s-2025-06-01-001
- created_at: 2025-06-01T02:00:00Z
- files:
  - path: evidence/logs/2025-05-31.gz
    sha256: abcd1234...
    size: 432112
- signed_by: redwood-kms:sign-v2
- previous_snapshot_hash: efgh5678... (optional)
- retention_label: extended
```

lucas (sre): For durability, keep manifest replicas in two regions when retention_label=extended OR legal-hold=true. Add sysmon alert if snapshot job misses SLA.

eva (product): Prioritization questions for roadmap: A) Gate extended retention to Dedicated/Private or offer as add-on? B) Make searchable exports GA or beta? C) SLA levels for on-demand freezes (24h vs 6h)?

dan (sales): Recommend: gate extended retention to paid enterprise with commitment. Make searchable exports a paid beta add-on; many customers will pay. 6h freeze SLA should be enterprise-only.

pia (legal): Also ensure export packages include chain-of-custody statements and plain-language manifest for auditors. Provide template attestation documents.

nora (security): Blocking items: BYOK signing flow and threat model, cross-region legal export checklist. Need both before GA.

sam (eng): Action items: @sam write tech spec for Snapshot API + manifest v1 (due Wed), include sampling/incremental strategy. @lucas add operational runbook and SLA monitors (due Wed). @nora produce BYOK threat model (due Fri). @pia draft contract language for extended retention and legal-hold (due Fri). @dan gather customer requirements for searchable exports (due Mon).

ops-bot: Roadmap note: place Snapshot API on Q3 candidate list if action items complete.

eva (product): Thanks all. If nobody objects I'll start a spec doc and attach this thread. Call out major blockers by EOD.

lucas (sre): No objections.

dan (sales): No objections, will sync with customers.

sam (eng): No blockers from eng side.

nora (security): Will flag if threat model finds issues.

eva (product): Closing thread."
